nodes_list: CraftsMan Generator (All-in-One), Load CraftsMan Pipeline, Preprocess Image (CraftsMan), Sample CraftsMan Latents, Decode CraftsMan Latents

name: ComfyUI-UniRig
description: This package provides automatic skeleton extraction and skinning for 3D meshes using UniRig, enabling rigging and pose manipulation for characters and objects.
nodes_list: UniRig: Extract Skeleton, UniRig: Apply Skinning, UniRig: Load Mesh, UniRig: Save Mesh, UniRig: Export Posed FBX

name: playbook-nodes
description: Provides nodes to integrate Playbook3D renders (including beauty, canny, depth, and mask passes) into ComfyUI workflows for 3D visualization purposes.

name: SAM3DObjects
description: Generates 3D Gaussian Splats and meshes from single images using SAM 3D Objects, supporting export to PLY, OBJ, and GLB formats.

name: ComfyUI-TripoSG
description: This package enables 3D mesh generation from a single image using the TripoSG model, integrating it into ComfyUI for 3D workflows.

name: ComfyUI-TripoSG
description: TripoSG is a high-fidelity image-to-3D generation model that produces detailed meshes from input images, leveraging rectified flow transformers and SDF-based supervision.

name: ComfyUI-Unique3D
description: This package integrates AiuniAI's Unique3D model into ComfyUI, enabling image-to-3D mesh generation workflows.

name: ComfyUI-ComfyUI-Hunyuan3DWrapper
description: This package provides wrapper nodes for Tencent's Hunyuan3D-2 model, enabling text-to-3D generation and texture processing within ComfyUI.

name: ComfyUI-DepthPro
description: Provides nodes for running Apple's DepthPro model to generate metric depth maps suitable for 3D projection and camera modeling.

name: ComfyUI-QuasimondoNodes
description: This package includes a 'Spring Mesh' node that distorts a mesh using motion maps or flows, which is relevant for 3D mesh processing.

name: ComfyUI Timesaver Nodes
description: This package includes a node for converting cubemap face images into equirectangular format, which is useful for 360-degree visualization and 3D scene representation.

name: DJZ-Nodes
description: Includes parametric 3D mesh creation capabilities among its extensive video and image processing tools.
